findings.summary: Sample checks correlate Intake-phase Requirements (R1, R2, R3) and Acceptance Tests (AT1, AT2, AT3) with Execution Milestone (M2), but M2 Exit Criteria do not cite or execute these tests. AT1-AT3 focus on run initiation constraints validated at Intake (M1).

evidence.note: M2 exit criteria cite execution/patching tests (AT13, AT14, AT20, etc.), not Intake tests.
AT1 definition: 'Attempt to initiate...'. Cannot be performed at M2 (Execution Complete).
evidence.quote: Attempt to initiate an Implementation Council run with inputs...

evidence.note: M1 exit criteria correctly cite AT1, AT2, AT3.
evidence.quote: All three input artifacts pass schema validation (AT2, AT3, AT1).
